statement.text: Both latest action-grouped variants execute successfully but lose both AUC and Logloss versus full and fixed; retain incumbent and negative results.

Action mean versus history mean loses AUC and loss; action reassignment versus history reassignment improves AUC slightly and worsens loss. The AUC operation contrast reverses; difference in differences -0.0003700170551184101.

Restricting scale reassignment to the same history/action does not rescue full-rule performance. Cross-action transport alone is insufficient to explain the observed penalty under this implementation; scale-direction/time/optimizer alternatives remain.
Whole-history mean/fixed near-best AUC does not imply any averaging rule suffices: action-conditioned mean is inferior. No universal adaptivity or semantic claim.

Committed diagnostics now report synthetic six-mode VJP checks, action-group conservation/activity and equal fixed-state forward outputs. Submission-time unknown results are superseded, with candidate-supplied/first-512 limitations retained.

Prioritize fixed six-arm scale/grouping repetition at seeds 43/44 in a later authorized phase. Older baselines/projection/cross/count trajectories retain their original single-seed scope; no further architecture search proposed.

plan.question: Does the observed interaction between scale grouping (whole history versus within action) and scale operation (mean versus reassignment) persist under source-isolated paired initializations, or is it seed-specific optimization? At seed 42, action mean minus history mean has validation AUC delta -0.0003149494455028101 and Logloss delta +0.00001095328867140033; action reassignment minus history reassignment has AUC delta +0.00005506760961559998 and Logloss delta +0.00010368999373616683. The AUC difference in differences, (action mean - action reassigned) - (history mean - history reassigned), is -0.0003700170551184101. Both action modes remain below the full and fixed-scale references in AUC. The fixed-scale incumbent exceeds full-rule AUC by only 0.000007154362010153292 and has worse Logloss. These are preliminary observations, not evidence of robust superiority or semantic relevance. Retrieve evidence needed to precommit a bounded six-arm comparison at paired seeds 43 and 44, retaining seed 42 and the frozen primary validation AUC. The mechanism hypothesis is sensitivity to scale-to-direction covariance and shared optimizer conditioning; action membership alone does not explain the observed reassignment penalty. Existing replay equality is reproducibility evidence, not an independent repetition. This follow-up is attribution and robustness work, not a new mechanism or novelty claim.
missing_information: Actual authorized source/config/checkpoint artifacts for the six existing scale modes, with hashes and common implementation comparison. Receipts identify artifacts but model sources and checkpoints are not exported in this query workspace. Verify forward computation, capacity, masking, floor/boundary rules, grouping, deterministic reassignment, RNG consumption, data order and checkpoint selection before further attribution.

Paired seeds 43 and 44 for the frozen six-arm suite: full, fixed 0.2 tangent, history mean, history reassigned, action mean and action reassigned. Precommit all paired AUC/Logloss deltas and the grouping-by-operation contrast before authorized execution. No additional coefficient or architecture search is justified by these observations.

Independent fixed-state gradient/VJP and, if a later authorized interface provides them, aggregate embedding-gradient and Adam-update diagnostics. Conserved scalar scale moments do not conserve gradient direction, update norm or optimizer state; deterministic reassignment also changes temporal and directional correlations.

Representative training-time and validation diagnostics beyond the candidate-authored ordered first 512 impressions. Existing diagnostics are dominated by one action and omit natural floor/boundary cases; cross-checkpoint differences cannot establish mediation. Preserve empty-history, rare-action and low-frequency slice counts and negative outcomes.

Authorized prediction vectors and user identities for paired user-cluster uncertainty estimates, if available in a later phase. Aggregate receipts cannot supply such intervals, significance or equivalence. Additional initializations do not remove adaptive validation-selection bias.
